create_CogVideoXVideoToVideoPipeline: create a CogVideoXVideoToVideoPipeline for video-to-video generation with a pretrained CogVideoX model
run_pipeline_video2video: run the CogVideoXVideoToVideoPipeline __call__ method to generate a video from an input video and text prompt
encode_prompt_text: encode text prompts into hidden state embeddings using the T5 text encoder with optional negative prompts
prepare_video_latents: prepare initial latents by encoding an input video through the VAE and adding noise at a given timestep
decode_latents_to_video: decode denoised video latents back to pixel-space frames using the VAE decoder
